hero.subline: A peer-to-peer skill network that connects students with domain experts whose identity has been independently verified.

trust.heading: Every Teacher is reviewed by a domain expert

pillars.title: Reviewed by domain experts
pillars.body: Skill evidence and teaching plans are assessed by experts in the matching domain before a Teacher is allowed to publish a class.

pillars.title: Decisions are recorded immutably
pillars.body: Each evidence submission is timestamped and kept as-is, so every approval and rejection is traceable across versions.

pillars.title: Manual student verification
pillars.body: Student IDs and enrollment confirmations are reviewed by hand using a standardized list of rejection reasons.

money.intro: No hidden fees, no volatile exchange rate. Money is recorded in an atomic ledger and reconciled automatically.

rate.label: Fixed exchange rate
rate.body: Direct 1:1 conversion with no hidden markup, no slippage on top-ups or withdrawals to your bank account.

split.label: Revenue allocation
split.note: Designed to respect the work of student teachers.

escrow.label: Atomic ledger
escrow.title: Held safely until completion
escrow.body: The learner's payment is held in the platform ledger. It only moves into the Teacher's wallet when the class is recorded as completed.
escrow.proof: Every transaction carries an end-to-end trace ID

cta.heading: Start learning or teaching today
cta.subline: Join students across universities who learn together, mentor each other, and earn transparently.

cta.trustNoCard: No credit card required to sign up

footer.tagline: A peer-to-peer skill ecosystem for students.

time.title: Start time
time.hint: Bookings close 24 hours before class so teachers can prepare.

banner.title: Payment protection
banner.body: Your credits are held safely in the ledger and only released to the teacher after a class is recorded as completed. If the teacher is absent or cancels before start, all credits are returned to your wallet automatically.

escrow.title: Ledger escrow protection
escrow.body: Credits are held safely in the ledger until the session ends and both sides confirm completion. If the teacher is absent, the credits are returned to your wallet automatically. Sharing personal contact information outside the platform is strictly forbidden to protect your right to dispute.

table.refundValue: Credits returned if teacher is absent

card.ruleBody: Your credits are held safely in the ledger. When you confirm completion, the credits are transferred to the teacher. If the teacher is absent for more than 15 minutes, the credits are returned to your wallet.
card.noShowBody: A no-show has been reported. The held credits will be returned to your wallet within 24 hours.
card.cancelledBody: This class has been cancelled. The held credits have been returned to your wallet.

wallet.title: Escrow wallet
wallet.noDirect: The teacher only receives the credits after you confirm completion.
wallet.refundPolicy: Credits are returned to your wallet automatically if the class is cancelled before the deadline.
wallet.signInToView: Sign in to see your wallet

charter.title: Learner rights
charter.noShowBody: If the teacher has not joined the room 15 minutes after the start time, the system automatically returns the held credits to your wallet.
charter.contactRule: Keep all contact inside the platform
charter.contactBody: Every message, file share and video call stays inside SkillSwap so the support team has a full record if a dispute is opened.

reviewModal.title: Review Session & Release Escrow
reviewModal.subtitle: Confirm that the session was completed successfully to release the held credits to the teacher.
reviewModal.commentPlaceholder: Share your learning experience, clarity, and mentor helpfulness...
reviewModal.pledge: Academic pledge: Honest reviews uphold transparent peer-mentoring standards across universities.

noShowModal.title: Report Teacher No-Show
noShowModal.subtitle: SkillSwap Learner Protection Rule
noShowModal.body: If the teacher did not join within 15 minutes of the start time, your report will be recorded and held escrow credits will automatically return to your wallet.

verificationBanner.title: Verified professional competency
verificationBanner.body: Your teaching profile meets the academic verification standard. The platform keeps every certificate and review transparent across faculties.
verificationBanner.ruleBody: Schedule and content lock as soon as the first learner books.

skill.label: Approved professional skill
skill.help: Per the verification standard, you can only publish classes for skills that have passed the academic review board. Skills still pending are not available.
